'''Byblos''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] known for its technological advances. Byblos also made a name for itself through the company [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]], which was founded during the [[Old Republic era|era of the Old Republic]]. At the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the planet was considered one of the busiest and most important planets in the Colonies. However, Byblos was affected by the suppression of several [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that were declared [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] by the Empire.

==Description==
Byblos was the headquarters of [[Byblos Drive Yards/Legends|Byblos Drive Yards]], and some other important technology brands maintained corporate towers there. It was a densely populated manufacturing center for high technology and military items. The natives built huge city towers, some of which had 5,000 levels or more. [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]], [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]], and [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] all maintained corporate towers on Byblos.

The average day lasted 38 standard hours and the year 402 local days.

Byblos was known for its vertical [[Prison/Legends|prisons]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

==History==
Like its neighbor [[Loronar/Legends|Loronar]], Byblos was colonized by [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] settlers before the founding of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Both worlds later declared their independence from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="TEA" />

Byblos joined the Galactic Republic early in its history, sometime between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], it supported [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the safety of factory workers on Byblos was gravely endangered through the works of hostile [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Quashing the Saboteurs}}</ref>

The planet did not secede during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the war, a [[Battle of Byblos|battle occurred on Byblos]], in which [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]] managed to get behind [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] lines by hijacking an [[SRT autonomous short-range transport|SRT droid]].

By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the planet had become an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]].<ref name="TEA" />
